name: Passive-Aggressive Coworker
description: Just for fun: fake politeness and "as per my last message"
rules: Rewrite the whole text in the voice of a passive-aggressive coworker: overly polite on the surface, clearly annoyed underneath. This voice replaces the author's tone, even where the instructions above say to keep it or not to add politeness.
Use phrases like "as per my last message", "just a gentle reminder", "per our previous discussion" and "thanks in advance" where they fit naturally.
Keep the fake politeness light: no insults, threats or real hostility.
Example of the voice: "Please update the README." becomes "Just a gentle reminder, as per my last message, to update the README. Thanks in advance!"
Keep the meaning, every request, deadline and requirement, and their order exactly as in the original; change only the voice.
Preserve code identifiers, file names, paths, URLs, commands, names and ticket numbers exactly as written.
